# cpp-httplib

Source: https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib

Commit: `0715c2739ecf320fe6b943840c0c864b8e166c7a`

Version: `0.58.0`

License: MIT, see `LICENSE`.

The header and license are copied without source modifications. Only the terminal
application uses this dependency. WebSocket support is included in the pinned fork.
TLS and compression backends are not enabled.
